content: Suspension vs deletion after non-payment: industry pattern is a staged ladder - short grace (days, service normal + reminders) -> suspension of access with data intact (AWS ~15-30 days, Microsoft days) -> termination/deletion only after prolonged non-payment, typically 60-90 days. Data retention guidance for startups: keep account data through a 30-90 day recovery window after deletion, purge from active systems promptly. Suspension must be reversible and must not destroy tenant data, otherwise reactivation is impossible and the churn becomes permanent. Grace period usage should be monitored to prevent abuse (serial lapsing).
